text:
Kait: quick preflight before I hand off to Alex in 10 — want to make sure PD/AWS/Grafana access is green. follow the checklist pls, ping if anything's busted. link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-preflight :point_right:

Jonas: copying checklist here so folks can run it fast:
- PagerDuty: can you log in, see "Redwood Prod" services, and trigger a test alert? (don't escalation-policy test prod customers)
- AWS: confirm you can `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall` via SSO and list /cloudwatch alarms
- Grafana: read access to redwood-prod dashboards + ability to mute/unmute alerts
- MFA + SSO: confirm you can get a session that lasts at least 1h
- Break-glass: know where the break-glass creds live and who holds the key (ops-sre)

Priya: quick status — I can access PD and Grafana, but AWS role fails for me with `AccessDenied` when calling `sts:AssumeRole` (SSO mapping probably missing). I'm primary tonight if we can't fix it?

Alex: I can take primary but only if I can assume the role. happy to be secondary otherwise. tagging @ops-bot for SSO mapping check.

ops-bot: SSO membership check completed for Priya and Alex: Priya -> groups: [engineers, oncall-infra], Alex -> groups: [engineers]. Missing group: oncall-infra for Alex.

Kait: ok that's likely it. @Jonas can you add Alex to `oncall-infra` group or add a temporary cross-account role mapping?

Jonas: will do. Quick remediation steps for Alex to test after I patch: 
1) re-run `aws sso login --profile redwood-prod`
2) `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --profile redwood-prod`
3) `aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --profile redwood-prod --region us-west-2`

Kait: PD check: Alex/Priya please verify you show up as responders on the following services: `redwood-api-prod`, `redwood-ingest-prod`. If not, file a PD user-add ticket or @Jonas will add you manually.

Alex: I see `redwood-api-prod` but not `redwood-ingest-prod` — looks like a subset of services are gated by the "sre-oncall" PD group.

Priya: On Grafana, I can view dashboards but not mute alerts (button is greyed out). Seems like "Editor" role required. Who manages org roles? @Kait?

Kait: Grafana roles are via the `grafana-admins` team in Okta; I'll escalate. For immediate mitigation, @Jonas can add you to the `oncall-viewers` team which lets you triage alerts (mute needs editor though).

Jonas: I've added Alex to oncall-infra and Priya to oncall-viewers. Alex — try the AWS assume-role again. Priya — try Grafana mute UI.

Alex: AWS assume-role now works, `aws sts get-caller-identity` returns the assumed role ARN. good to go as primary.

Priya: Grafana still greyed out for mute, but I can see alert details and run panels. I'll rely on Alex for muting for now.

incident-bot: NOTE: scheduled handoff in 10 minutes (2026-03-14T02:00:00Z). Current oncall: Kait (primary) -> handing to Alex. Secondary: Priya.

Kait: action items before handoff:
- Alex: confirm PD escalation test (trigger low-severity test to your phone)
- Jonas: ensure Alex is in `sre-oncall` PD group or add the two services to his user directly
- Priya: confirm Grafana editor role followup ticket (I've created D-12345)
- All: confirm you have runbook link and know the page flow: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incidents/prod-paging

Alex: doing PD test now — paging my phone via PD test, got a push and SMS within 30s. Phone is green.

Jonas: I added Alex to `sre-oncall` in PD and added him to `redwood-ingest-prod` service responders. Priya, you should see ingest now as well (check PD -> Services -> redwood-ingest-prod -> Responders).

Priya: I see it now. thanks.

Kait: gap note: APAC overnight window is uncovered between 23:00–02:00 UTC if we don't get another volunteer; Alex/Priya please call out if you need a swap. We should be able to handle secondary coverage via rotation but prefer to have someone local.

Alex: I can extend by 1.5h if needed, but prefer not to exceed 3h. Priya can take first hour APAC if needed.

Kait: final sanity checks done. Handing off in 2. primary -> Alex, secondary -> Priya. If anything else pops up please escalate via PD urgent and DM me directly.

Jonas: leaving a tiny troubleshooting snippet (useful for future thread):
```
# verify assume-role and cw alarms
aws sso login --profile redwood-prod
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --profile redwood-prod --role-session-name oncall-test
aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --profile redwood-prod --region us-west-2 | jq '.MetricAlarms[] | {AlarmName,StateValue}'
```
Kait: thanks team. handoff complete — Alex you're primary now. :rocket:
